in_reply_to: the Library's reply of 14 Oct 2026 in the thread 'Aldrich Family Papers (Rokeby Collection) microfilm: John Armstrong's French ministry, a cipher key?' (reply in-thread from the project mailbox, not a new message)
subject: Re: Aldrich Family Papers (Rokeby Collection) microfilm: John Armstrong's French ministry, a cipher key?
body:
Dear [name as signed in the Library's reply],

Thank you for examining the film and for your answer. Yes, I would like to proceed with the order for the pages with numerical code and decoding in the letters from John Armstrong dated from December 1804, at the USD 20.00 minimum charge. Please send the payment instructions.

Two requests about the images, if they fit within the same order. Legibility matters more than format for us: the numerals and the small decoding written above or beside them have to be readable one figure at a time, so if a scan of a printed page is sharper than a screen shot, I would prefer the scan, at the highest resolution you can send. And could each image carry the roll's frame or item identifier, and could the pages include the address or docket side of each letter where there is one, so that we can tell to whom each letter was written?

Once we have read the pages I will send you a short note of what the code pages turn out to be (which cipher, and whether the decoding is complete), for the collection file. Everything we do with them is logged in the public repository: https://github.com/NoAutopilot/cipher-lab/tree/main/ciphers/armstrong-madison-1808

Thank you again.

[SIGN-OFF]
